claim_boundary: Certifies the smallest two-jet five-charge derived Kuranishi carrier and the first exact obstruction to pulling the ambient linear Einstein--Weyl cofiber sequence through it. It does not classify higher Kuranishi brackets, construct an all-orders groupoid slice, identify the common zero fibre with a linear subspace, or establish bounded, causal, particle, positivity or quantum claims.

constraint_algebroid_two_jet.anchor: rho_z(N,X)=Hamiltonian vector field of H_z[N]+H_i,z[X] on canonical data z
constraint_algebroid_two_jet.bracket: [(N,X),(M,Y)]_z=(L_X M-L_Y N,[X,Y]+h_z^{-1}(N dM-M dN)); vertical first-class terms retained as an ideal
constraint_algebroid_two_jet.bundle: lapse-shift deformation parameters over the open positive-metric Sobolev phase space, with the based Weyl/U1 vertical ideal contracted because it contributes no adjoint cokernel
constraint_algebroid_two_jet.closure: [rho(a),rho(b)]=rho([a,b]_z) on the constraint surface through the declared two-jet, by the canonical Poisson identity; the anchor derivative of h^{-1} is part of the equality
constraint_algebroid_two_jet.fixed_group_mutation: dropping the epsilon*q term changes the exact sin/cos bracket and reproduces the rejected fixed-group AMM assumption

finite_harmonic_crosswalk.resonant_functionals: carrier-dependent bounded/quasiperiodic functionals are not extra compact-Cauchy cokernel coordinates
finite_harmonic_crosswalk.restriction: l2 restricts to the five certified Taub/moment maps on every finite harmonic input

functorial_pullback_obstruction.Schur_pairing: the target-internal Schur complement remains defined on the ambient target and can be restricted along a chosen common-zero inclusion, but it is not a quotient pairing on a nonexistent projected extra zero fibre
functorial_pullback_obstruction.Sobolev_boundary: the balanced finite-harmonic witness already refutes functoriality; no finite-harmonic density argument is used to claim a Sobolev exact sequence
functorial_pullback_obstruction.conclusion: the cofiber projection does not restrict to the common five-charge zero fibre; therefore the linear exact sequence cannot be pulled back as a sequence of the three individual derived zero fibres
functorial_pullback_obstruction.linear_sequence: 0 -> H0_EM -> H0_WM -> H0_extra -> 0 remains certified before the derived charge restriction
functorial_pullback_obstruction.reason: mu is quadratic and additive on the orthogonal invariant primary split, so mu_E+mu_X=0 does not imply mu_X=0

kuranishi_derived_carrier.kernel: K=ker DC_zbar in the declared Sobolev slice
kuranishi_derived_carrier.koszul_model: Sym(K*)_(degree<=2) tensor Lambda(eta_H,eta_Px,eta_J1,eta_J2,eta_J3), d eta_A=kappa_2,A and dK*=0
kuranishi_derived_carrier.nilpotency: d^2=0 exactly at two-jet because d(kappa_2)=0 in the Koszul model
kuranishi_derived_carrier.tangent_complex: K -> O with zero linear differential; H0=K and obstruction H1=O
kuranishi_derived_carrier.warning: this is the derived quadratic fibre, not a claim that the full Kuranishi map has no cubic or higher terms

mutations.project_balanced_mode_to_extra_zero_fibr: REJECTED: total mu_H=0 but both projected charges are exact nonzero opposites
mutations.replace_derived_fibre_by_linear_kernel: REJECTED because Dkappa(0)=0 while kappa_2 is nonzero quadratic

next_gate: replace the false quotient sequence by a derived correspondence/fibre-product description that retains balanced Einstein-extra charge cancellation; higher Kuranishi terms require a separate all-orders algebroid theorem
